response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, cnt AS record_count, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, cnt * 1.0 / AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM c
